name: delivery-team
description: Work-item-driven, sprint-based autonomous software delivery on a pluggable backend (Azure DevOps or GitHub): role-agents + ceremony skills orchestrated by atl work dispatch over claude -p workers.

agents.name: intake
agents.description: The delivery org's conversational front door — runs live in /kickoff, elicits vision and requirements from the human PO, and hands a structured framing to the business-analyst.

agents.name: business-analyst
agents.description: Turns intake discovery into Epics and Features with fixed-heading business analysis, and owns the Domain and business-side Analysis durable-knowledge for the delivery org.

agents.name: technical-analyst
agents.description: Enriches Features/PBIs after the business-analyst with technical analysis — approach, feasibility, NFRs, dependencies, suggested areas — as a sentinel-labeled comment.

agents.name: project-manager
agents.description: Plans sprints for the delivery org: builds the dependency DAG, admits the right items by priority — against a velocity-derived capacity ceiling under scrum mode, against no ceiling under flow, where the admitted set is kept DAG-closed — and writes the sprint-review report.

agents.name: tech-lead
agents.description: The delivery-team's highest-context technical role: decomposes Features into keyed work-units, owns the architecture + conventions durable-knowledge, briefs workers, and gates review pre-merge.

agents.name: developer
agents.description: The delivery-team's generic implementer: a fresh isolated claude -p worker per work-unit that loads its tagged area's stack-pack, builds and self-tests in its own worktree, and hands off at PR.

agents.name: tester
agents.description: Independent Level-2 verification — a fresh delivery-team worker per work-unit that probes coverage, edges, and regression, attaches evidence, and gates the loop with a verdict.

skills.name: delivery-init
skills.description: /delivery-init — connect a project to its backend (azure | github): select it, discover coordinates, probe connectivity, pick the sprint mode (scrum | flow), then write .delivery/config.json (secret-by-reference) + methodology.json.

skills.name: kickoff
skills.description: /kickoff — greenfield cold-start: live PO intake, then the business-analyst + technical-analyst create the first Epics/Features and seed the Domain/Architecture durable-knowledge. Run once after /delivery-init.

skills.name: refine
skills.description: /refine — recurring backlog refinement: the analysts + tech-lead decompose analyzed Features into keyed, area-tagged, dependency-linked work-units, each with a canonical developer brief.

skills.name: sprint-plan
skills.description: /sprint-plan — sprint selection, mode-aware: capacity from the last N=3 closed sprints bounds admission under the scrum mode, while the flow mode has no ceiling and admits by priority with the admitted set kept DAG-closed. The project-manager admits at one granularity and stamps the sprint carrier (iteration field / sprint:<slug> label).

skills.name: sprint-start
skills.description: /sprint-start — build the sprint's dependency DAG, fail-fast on a cycle or a missing mobile emulator, materialize .delivery/plan.json, and hand off to the atl work dispatch engine.

skills.name: sprint-review
skills.description: /sprint-review — sprint-end: compile the Sprint Review Report (completed, PRs, evidence, dev preview, velocity under the scrum mode, findings, promotion decision) and run the commit-bound PO gate — dev→release merges only for the exact commit a durable approval record names (GitHub backend in v1).

skills.name: request
skills.description: /request — mid-project request intake: capture a PO- or team-raised request as a candidate, triage it, run feasibility, then gate it at an honest PO dialectic before it becomes backlog work.

skills.name: work-new
skills.description: /work-new <title> — open one work item by hand, in the right place in the hierarchy: infer the type, find or propose a parent, elicit only what is missing, and stamp a manual-provenance key so a re-run converges. The light sibling of /request.

skills.name: work-start
skills.description: /work-start <id> — claim a unit and build it, in a session the human is steering: refuse it if the dispatch engine owns it, resolve the sprint carrier, cut the engine's own delivery/<slug>/<id> branch off a fresh integration branch, move it to In Progress, brief from the card, load the area's pack, then implement. --prep-only stops after the briefing.

skills.name: work-finish
skills.description: /work-finish — close out the unit on the current delivery branch: gate on a scoped build and tests, push, open or update the PR to the integration branch with the item linked, and verify the link by reading it back. Never merges, never moves state.

skills.name: work-move
skills.description: /work-move <id> <state> — the drive loop's only state writer. Writes every surface a state spans in one pass, reads the result back, refuses an illegal transition with the legal ones named, and guards Done against a PR that never merged.

skills.name: work-sync
skills.description: /work-sync [dry-run] — sweep the board for drift between what the code says and what the item says: a merged PR still in flight, a Done item with no merge, an orphan branch, a double sprint carrier. Reports with evidence, then fixes as a batch.

skills.name: work-list
skills.description: /work-list [mine|active|sprint|blocked|backlog|<type>] — read-only view of the board for a human working a queue: server-side filters where the backend allows, candidates excluded from the ready frontier, rendered as a grouped table. Writes nothing.

areas.name: web
areas.description: React + TypeScript + Vite frontend — the web surface (preview / chrome-devtools MCP + code CI).

areas.name: mobile
areas.description: Flutter + Dart mobile app — the emulator surface (booted simulator/emulator + code CI).

areas.name: api
areas.description: Node.js + Express + TypeScript backend API — the code surface (unit + integration CI).
